config.async_ratio_note: recorded as 2 until --async-ratio was threaded: the shared parser declared the flag and standard_main never passed it to run_port, so a command line asking for 2 ran at run_port's default of 1. The Run it command on this row's docs/algo-*.md page pins 1.

domain_reference_points.note: measured directly on all 48 items at temperature 0.0; the two ceilings are what a prompt can reach by naming the convention alone versus also teaching the working

an_earlier_run_of_this_exact_command.note: same script, same code, same seeds. The seed fixes the data splits and the operator sampler, not the model, which is sampled at temperature 0.7 -- so one run per seed does not pin a number

reflective_merge_control.note: paired runs at the same seed with the model merge on and off. `--reflective-merge` was accepted by all eleven ports and never read, so an earlier version of this control compared two identical configurations
reflective_merge_control.finding: the model merge costs 2.7-2.8x fewer calls at no cost in quality, because it replaces ranking contested diffs on the cheap layer and ranking needs evaluations
